old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-7n4i","title":"Default TOFU mesh bootstrap cannot authenticate an unknown Announce","description":"LinkLayer.receive requires _find_sender to locate a pre-existing peer key before it can verify any link signature. _find_sender only checks self, rekeyed peers, peer_lookup, and peer_lookup_all; Node supplies only its existing peer_db. Yet the offline baseline requires learning an unknown peer's public key from its signed Announce and Node._process_announce adds that peer only after LinkLayer.receive succeeds. Starting with the default empty peer_db therefore rejects every discovery Announce as BAD_SIGNATURE and can never form a TOFU mesh. Add a bounded, structurally parsed Announce bootstrap candidate path that derives/checks SIID, verifies the link signature and inner Announce signature before pinning, without admitting arbitrary payload keys; add empty-node mutual discovery and malformed-candidate regressions.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T14:55:05.456075Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T14:55:05.456075Z"}
